items.title: Meta Ads: $53.20 spend, 7 leads, $7.60 CPL — Flooring Problems Campaign
items.summary: Yesterday (2026-09-09) Meta spent $53.20, all on the sole actively-delivering campaign, Flooring Problems Campaign, generating 7 leads at $7.60 CPL. That's well under the 7-day baseline (2026-09-03 to 2026-09-09: $346.94 / 30 leads, ~$11.56 CPL), so no anomaly; account is ACTIVE and no ads are flagged.

needs_attention: Flooring Problems Campaign's raw actions again include lead-like conversion types outside the script's documented LEAD_ACTION_TYPES set (offsite_complete_registration_add_meta_leads, offsite_search_add_meta_leads, offsite_content_view_add_meta_leads — each valued at 7, matching the counted leads exactly, same as flagged on 2026-08-31, 2026-09-02, 2026-09-07, and 2026-09-08). No discrepancy in the counted total so far, but this is now the fifth consecutive run seeing it — the script's lead-action set should be extended rather than continuing to hand-note it.

The most recent prior meta-ads.json on this branch is 2026-09-08. Per the orchestrator's instruction this run, 2026-09-09's daily-ingest completed normally but its raw ingest files landed on an unmerged session branch (confirmed via the vault's 01_daily/2026-09-09.md note) — a known branch-isolation artifact, not a missed run. Today's pull correctly used the standard 1-day window (2026-09-09) with no gap to widen.
